changelog: NEW (DEV-ONLY): 'Play next episode' card. While watching a series, a bottom-right card appears 60 s before the credits with the upcoming episode's still, S/E label, runtime, plot snippet, and a 10-second countdown ring. Pick 'Play next episode' or 'Stay on this one' — countdown auto-fires Play Next if you do nothing. BACK = Stay. Focus auto-grabs the primary button so OK confirms immediately. Card never blocks the underlying video and never steals D-pad input for the player.
FIX: Resolves Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning (canada channel only, but inherited here).
FIX: Player on-screen options menu D-pad focus.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
